name: Booking Resort Co.,Ltd.
summary: Booking Resort Co., Ltd. operates accommodation facilities in Japan. The company operates resort-glamping.com, a booking platform for glamping and resort facilities; and Inuyado, a hotel for pet tourism. It also engages in the provision of customer attraction support for glamping, resort villas, and pet-friendly accommodations; management of dog villas; and accommodation facility revitalization projects. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Booking Resort Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of SN Holdings Co.,Ltd.
